visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a retail cosmetics store aisle filled with shelves of 'Browit' eyebrow products. A hand with red-tipped fingernails reaches out and picks up a 'Browit Aris Long Stay' eyebrow pencil in 'Rosewood Brown'. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room where a young woman with long, straight dark hair and a white graphic t-shirt is holding the product. She has full makeup on and looks directly at the camera. (3) She removes the cap of the eyebrow pencil, revealing a slanted brush applicator. She then applies the dark gel-like product to the back of her hand, creating a dark smudge to show the color and texture. (4) A close-up shows her carefully applying the product to her left eyebrow using the slanted brush. She looks focused, with her mouth slightly open. (5) She looks into the camera, reacting with a surprised and slightly worried expression as her left eyebrow looks very dark and bold. She compares it to the right one. (6) A man is briefly visible in the background sitting on a bed, looking at his phone. The woman continues talking and gesturing with the product in her hand. (7) She applies the product to her other eyebrow. She rubs the smudge on her hand vigorously with her fingers to demonstrate its waterproof and smudge-proof quality. (8) The video ends with her smiling at the camera, holding the product, and pointing downwards to encourage viewer interaction.
